behaviors.description: Report running instance ID through supplied descriptor.
behaviors.preconditions: Controlled writable descriptor and background hold probe.
behaviors.expected: Written decimal instance ID equals public ps row for app and launched PID.

behaviors.description: Revoke network granted in app metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app metadata variant grants network; controlled loopback TCP listener.
behaviors.expected: Default connection accepted; run unshare makes probe connection fail.

behaviors.preconditions: Independent metadata variant names unavailable SDK and available runtime.
behaviors.expected: Normal run outputs A; devel fails identifying missing SDK.

behaviors.description: Restrict application permission with sandbox mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Stored filesystem grant exposes controlled host marker.
behaviors.expected: Normal run reads marker; sandbox mode denies probe read.

behaviors.description: Share and revoke host network namespace with run and stored overrides.
behaviors.preconditions: Local TCP listener on loopback and no metadata network grant.
behaviors.expected: Default connect fails, run/stored share connect and accept, run/stored unshare fail in probe.

behaviors.preconditions: Local loopback TCP server and conditional permissions support.
behaviors.expected: True condition connects and is accepted; false condition fails in probe.

behaviors.description: Select architecture, branch and runtime version.
behaviors.preconditions: A app and runtime on nondefault test branch.
behaviors.expected: Selected app executes; absent branch/runtime rejected; runtime-version overrides missing runtime tuple version.

behaviors.description: Enumerate and kill a running instance.
behaviors.preconditions: Probe holds a background application process.
behaviors.expected: Selected ps columns identify app and live process IDs; kill stops instance and removes ps row.

behaviors.description: Enter running instance with its environment and argument forwarding.
behaviors.preconditions: Probe holds background app with distinct environment value.
behaviors.expected: Entered probe sees app variable and exact arguments; instance cleaned through kill.

behaviors.description: Grant and revoke host shared-memory device access.
behaviors.expected: Marker readable only under run/stored shm grants, absent after respective revocations.

behaviors.description: Select runnable app branch and its public desktop export.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B branch commits with distinct desktop names and probe output.
behaviors.expected: Both branch selections change unqualified run output and public exported desktop name.

mappings.rationale: Descriptor ID independently cross-checked with public ps and launch PID.

surface_assertions.rationale: Written instance ID matches ps row for the held application and launched PID.

mappings.rationale: Independent metadata grants network; accepted control connection becomes probe failure under run unshare.
Distinct unavailable SDK and available runtime prove development runtime selection.

surface_assertions.rationale: Normal launch succeeds; devel selects missing SDK and identifies it in failure.

mappings.rationale: Granted host marker access revoked by restrictive mode.

surface_assertions.rationale: Probe cannot read controlled host marker despite stored filesystem grant.

mappings.rationale: Local TCP observations check run and stored namespace grant/revocation, not metadata network precedence.

surface_assertions.rationale: network grant enables loopback connection accepted by controlled server.
network revocation blocks connection despite stored network grant.
Stored network grant enables local TCP connection accepted by server.
Stored network revocation causes probe connect failure.

mappings.rationale: Local TCP success/denial follows true/false condition.

surface_assertions.rationale: network:true permits accepted host connection; network:false fails from probe.

mappings.rationale: Explicit installed selections execute; absent selections fail instead of falling back.

surface_assertions.rationale: Native architecture runs A; valid unavailable architecture is refused rather than falling back, and ordinary launch still runs A.
Installed test branch runs A; absent branch is rejected.
Absent runtime ID rejected; valid runtime with version override executes app probe.
Missing runtime version rejected; requested installed version overrides missing version in runtime tuple.

mappings.rationale: Selected ps instance/app/process columns identify live PIDs; kill stops process and removes row.
Entered probe reports exact running app environment and forwards spaced/literal arguments.
Actual controlled /dev/shm file visibility, specifically shm and no other device.

surface_assertions.rationale: shm grant makes controlled host /dev/shm marker readable.
shm denial hides marker despite stored shm grant.
Stored shm grant makes host marker readable.
Stored shm denial hides host marker.

mappings.rationale: Both selections change actual unqualified launch A/B output and public desktop export name.

surface_assertions.rationale: Native selections change launch and export; selecting the other branch at a valid unavailable architecture fails and preserves current launch version and exact exported bytes.
